description: What parseLpsFile reads out of each .LPS in ../sqlite: the set's name (the file name without .lps) and every readable point, in table order. Ids are left out. A missing elevation is null; an elevation that is not a number is null.

errors.not SQLite: This doesn't look like an .LPS local points file.
errors.no Points table: No Points table found — is this an .LPS local points file?
errors.no readable points: This .LPS file contains no readable points.
